title: The secret behind Ezio's feathers in Assassin's Creed 2
subject: ezio
description:
Did you collect all 100 feathers? 👇

The story behind the feather collectibles in Assassin's Creed II and the brother Ezio lost. Spoilers for Assassin's Creed II.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Ubisoft. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Ezio Auditore spent years collecting feathers for a dead boy.
The boy was Petruccio, his youngest brother. Back in Florence, Ezio used to climb rooftops to bring him feathers.
In December 1476, Petruccio was hanged beside their father and Federico in the Piazza della Signoria.
Their mother, Maria, stopped speaking after that day.
So Ezio kept looking. One hundred feathers are hidden across Florence, Venice and the Tuscan hills, and each one goes back to Maria at Monteriggioni.
Most players gather them for a trophy, without noticing its name: In Memory of Petruccio.
